from solution import sum_of_alternates


def test_issue_example_from_issue():
    """Example asserts sum_of_alternates((5, 6, 3, 6, 10, 34)) == (46, 18)."""
    assert sum_of_alternates((5, 6, 3, 6, 10, 34)) == (46, 18)  # 6+6+34=46, 5+3+10=18


def test_issue_four_elements_even_length():
    """Alternate sums put odd-index sum first as in example (46, 18)."""
    assert sum_of_alternates((1, 2, 3, 4)) == (6, 4)  # 2+4=6, 1+3=4


def test_issue_three_elements_odd_length():
    """Alternate sums put odd-index sum first as in example (46, 18)."""
    assert sum_of_alternates((1, 2, 3)) == (2, 4)  # 2=2, 1+3=4


def test_issue_single_element():
    """Alternate sums put odd-index sum first as in example (46, 18)."""
    assert sum_of_alternates((7,)) == (0, 7)  # sum([])=0, 7=7


def test_issue_two_elements():
    """Alternate sums put odd-index sum first as in example (46, 18)."""
    assert sum_of_alternates((4, 9)) == (9, 4)  # 9=9, 4=4


def test_issue_empty_tuple():
    """Alternate sums of empty tuple are zero pair as in example sums."""
    assert sum_of_alternates(()) == (0, 0)  # sum([])=0, sum([])=0


def test_issue_negative_numbers():
    """Alternate sums put odd-index sum first as in example (46, 18)."""
    assert sum_of_alternates((-1, -2, -3, -4)) == (-6, -4)  # -2+-4=-6, -1+-3=-4


def test_issue_zeros_in_even_positions():
    """Alternate sums put odd-index sum first as in example (46, 18)."""
    assert sum_of_alternates((0, 5, 0, 7)) == (12, 0)  # 5+7=12, 0+0=0


def test_issue_five_elements_odd_length():
    """Alternate sums put odd-index sum first as in example (46, 18)."""
    assert sum_of_alternates((10, 20, 30, 40, 50)) == (60, 90)  # 20+40=60, 10+30+50=90


def test_contract_returns_tuple():
    """Example returns a tuple pair (46, 18)."""
    assert isinstance(sum_of_alternates((5, 6, 3, 6, 10, 34)), tuple)


def test_contract_returns_two_values():
    """Example returns a pair of sums (46, 18)."""
    assert len(sum_of_alternates((1, 2, 3, 4))) == 2  # pair has 2 sums


def test_contract_input_not_modified():
    """Function extracts sums without changing the input tuple."""
    data = (1, 2, 3, 4)  # input tuple with 4 items
    sum_of_alternates(data)
    assert data == (1, 2, 3, 4)  # unchanged: 1,2,3,4
